batting.name: W Jaffer
batting.dismissal: c U Kaul b S Sreesanth

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c S Sreesanth b IK Pathan

batting.name: R Dravid
batting.dismissal: c DPMD Jayawardene b VRV Singh

batting.name: P Kumar
batting.dismissal: c U Kaul b PP Chawla

batting.name: JR Hopes
batting.dismissal: c CL White b Z Khan

batting.name: RR Sarwan
batting.dismissal: c DT Patil b P Kumar

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c DT Patil b P Kumar

balls.text: another run out and Bangalore's innings is over, Steyn digs the yorker and the ball lobs up towards the keeper, Kumble sets off for the single from the non-striker's end but is caught short by the under-arm throw from Kaul who hits the stumps direct
the slower ball bowled full outside off stump, Steyn tries to smash it down the ground but misses by quite a bit
Steyn moves forward and drives a full ball towards long off for a single
Kumble pushes the ball towards mid-on, Kumble sets off for the single and would have been out once again had the fielder hit the stumps at the bowler's end
Kumble tries defend on the back foot but misses
caught! That is a crucial moment in the game, Dravid tries to go over cover once again but gets a thick outside edge that flies straight to Jayawardene who judges the catch superbly at third man
that is the first six of the innings and what a shot that is! Dravid gets under a full ball outside off stump and launches it flat over extra cover
Kumble moves back and across and pushes a good length ball towards midwicket, he sets off for the single and would have been miles out had Pathan hit at the bowler's end
Kumble moves forward and sweeps the ball from wide outside off stump towards deep square leg, Dravid won't be on strike at the start of the 19th over
Kumble tries to play the paddle sweep but doesn't make contact
Kumble leans forward and blocks once again
tossed up on off stump, driven back to the bowler on the front foot

bowled him! That is quite senseless batting, Zaheer should have been looking to give Dravid strike but he tries to play the big drive to a googly that pitches outside off stump and spins into him, the ball goes between bat and pad and hits off stump
bowled flat on middle stump, Dravid leans forward and clips the ball off his pads to deep square leg
driven down the ground for a single, Dravid keeps the strike, he is playing an invaluable innings for his team
too full on middle stump, Dravid leans forward and flicks the ball powerfully through midwicket for four, Dravid has now made the highest score by a Royal Challenger

shot! Dravid waits for a short of a length ball to angle into him and he opens the face to guide the ball towards third man, he's timed it so well that the ball screams over the boundary, sublime from Dravid
short and wide outside off stump, Dravid cuts hard but straight to backward point
short ball and Dravid has hooked it superbly to the deep square leg boundary, rolled his wrists and kept the ball down

another awful mix-up, Dravid leans forward to drive a full ball firmly towards mid-on, it was Dravid's call and he didn't want the single, Patil however had run all the way down from the non-striker's end and was stranded as Pathan threw the ball back to VRV
tossed up on middle stump, Patiil leans across his stumps and plays a fine paddle sweep, Sreesanth prepares to field the ball on the boundary but lets it go through him, shocking fielding from Punjab

caught! Chawla strikes again, Praveen tries to cut one off the back foot without moving his feet, the ball bounces a bit more and takes the edge through to Uday Kaul, Bangalore once again lose two in an over and they've been severely set back once again
big turn! Chawla loops the ball into the right-hander, pitches outside off and then spins it sharply away from Praveen who lets it go
lbw! Misbah moved his front foot forward and tried to defend, the ball hit him in line with middle and would have gone on to hit off, Doctrove took a good long look at it and raised the finger
defended on the front foot towards the off side
inside edged towards short fine leg, he was looking to cut that
a full toss on middle stump, Misbah moves forward and drives the ball towards wide long-on, Pathan fields on the boundary
Misbah walks down the pitch and flicks a full ball off his pads, more of an on-drive really, through midwicket for four, awesome timing and perfect balance
the slower ball on off stump, Dravid leans forward and drives the ball towards cover for  a single
shot! Dravid leans forward to a half-volley outside off stump and drives the ball powerfully through extra cover, that was a text-book shot but oh so effective
tight line and length on off stump, Misbah pushes the ball towards point and calls for the single, the overthrow goes towards long on but they don't run the extra run
good length delivery on off and middle stump, driven off the front foot towards long off for  a single
Misbah tries to smash the ball down the ground but misses, Kaul whips off the bails but Misbah just gets his back foot behind the line, that may have been a seven ball over

that's another googly but the line is down leg side, Misbah moves back and gets a faint tickle on to it, VRV gives chase from short fine leg and reaches the ball but can't get down quickly enough to field the ball, another poor effort
Dravid moves back to cut the googly and hits it to Pathan, who has replaced VRV at short third man
bowled flat through the air on off stump, Dravid moves back in his crease and drives to cover
Dravid moves back and pushes the ball into the huge gap at midwicket for two
bowled wide outside off, Dravid misses the ball
short and wide outside off stump, Dravid cuts hard towards short third man and  VRV mis-fields to allow the boundary
a bit too full this time on the pads, Dravid moves forward and across and flicks the ball towards deep midwicket
slower ball outside off stump, the length is good and Dravid opens the face to play the ball to point
full ball in the blockhole outside off stump, Dravid tried to squeeze it out of the off side but misses
too short and Misbah gets off the mark by moving across his stumps and pulling the ball towards deep square leg
good length delivery outside off stump, Dravid waits in his crease and uses the room to cut the ball towards third man

caught! The change in bowling works, Pathan begins the over with a slower ball wide outside off stump, it might have been wide if Kohli had let it go, he tries to hit the ball straight but the change of pace foxes him and he ends up swatting a simple catch towards Sreesanth at long off
Dravid tries to defend a ball that cuts into him and gets an inside edge that just misses his stumps, he then tries to steal the single but scrambles back before the keeper fields the ball
that's too short and Dravid has clobbered it, he rocked back and pulled the ball hard but all along the ground to the deep square leg boundary
good length delivery angling into the right-hander, played towards midwicket on the front foot
Dravid tries to pull this time but doesn't make proper contact
short of a length on middle stump, nudged off the hips towards square leg for one
Kohli plants his front foot forward and smashes a length ball from Hopes to the long off boundary, he can hit it extremely hard can Kohli

dropped! Kohli charges Sreesanth once again and swings wildly, this time he connects and gets a top edge that flies miles in the air, it's a swirling catch somewhere in the region behind midwicket, Hopes runs back and tries to settle under it, he catches it initially but as he falls towards the ground the ball slips out of his hand
fuller ball angling into off stump, Kohli watchfully opens the face and plays the ball towards backward point, Marsh prevents the single
now that is rash, Kohli charges Sreesanth and has a wild swing at a short of a length ball outside off stump, he missed it by quite a bit
a full ball swings into the right-hander, Dravid moves forward and drives the ball firmly from middle stump towards long on
short of a length outside off stump, Kohli waits on the back foot and guides the ball with an open face towards third man

full ball outside off stump, Kohli strides forward and drives the ball powerfully through covers, he's smashed that hard and the ball races to the boundary, he's strong through the cover area and scored a lot of his runs during the under-19 World Cup in that region
Dravid charges Chawla and tries to smash him straight down the ground, he doesn't make proper contact and mis-hits the ball through midwicket
bowled flat through the air on leg stump from round the wicket, Kohli goes back and defends back past the bowler
short ball and Dravid moves back to cut the ball to the fielder on the sweeper boundary
that one pitched on the stumps and spun sharply past the outside edge of Dravid's forward defence
pitches outside leg stump and angles into the pads, Kohli flicks off the back foot through square leg
bowled slowly through the air on middle stump, Dravid leans forward and flicks to deep square leg
short of a length just outside off stump, Dravid mis-times the cut through cover but he's placed it in the gap and will retain strike
fuller length this time on middle and leg, Dravid moves back and flicks the ball off his pads towards deep backward square leg where Pathan fields well but throws poorly
short of a length delivery angles into the right-hander and then straightens off the pitch, Dravid fends at it and gets beaten
too straight from VRV on middle and leg stump, Kohli moves his front foot across his stumps and plays the leg glance towards fine leg
good length delivery angling into off stump, Kohli waits in his crease and defends towards point
short of a length and wide outside off stump, Dravid plays the square drive through cover point for a single

Kohli sees a little bit of width outside off and slashes hard, the ball is only a little bit to VRV's right at third man but Kohli's hit it so hard that VRV can't reach it, a quicker fielder might have
full and wide outside off stump, Dravid reaches out for it off the front foot and drives the ball to the fielder on the point boundary
Kohli waits in his crease and pushes a good length ball towards mid on, Jayawardene runs across from midwicket but can't cut it off, the run a quick single
good length delivery pitches outside off stump and angles into the right-hander, Dravid waits for it and chops the ball down to third man off the back foot, more work for VRV in the deep
good length once again but the line is outside off stump, Kohli steers the ball towards VRV at third man
good length from Gagandeep on off and middle stump, Kohli moves back and across and defends towards the leg side
a good length delivery on off stump pushes Dravid back in his crease, he defends on the back foot towards the bowler
defended on the front foot back to the bowler

excellent ball and an outstanding shot, VRV got the ball to bounce sharply into Dravid's chest, Dravid jumped up on the back foot, rode the bounce and steered it down past the fielder at slip for four to third man, excellent control
good ball, VRV pitches on a good length outside off stump and angles the ball into Dravid who begins to defend on the front foot, the ball straightens off the pitch and beats the bat
Kohli moves well across his stumps and flicks a full ball from off and middle towards deep backward square leg
better delivery, pitches on a good length and angles into Kohli's off stump, Kohli moves forward and defends back to the bowler
a full ball slants down leg side, Kohli tries to flick by moving forward and across but can't make contact, VRV starts with a wide
good length delivery on off and middle stump, Dravid moves forward and defends back to the bowler
Dravid stays in his crease and pushes towards a ball outside off stump, he gets beaten
defended off the front foot towards the off side
Dravid comes forward and drives the ball uppishly towards mid-on, the ball falls well short of Pathan and he misfields to allow the boundary
a fullish ball swings into the right-hander, Dravid moves forward and clips the ball off his pads through midwicket
played down towards third man for one, another poor throw from VRV in the deep

there's a loud appeal for caught behind but umpire Davis shakes his head in the negative, Dravid stayed in his crease and tried to cut a short of a length ball through point, the ball moved away from him and beat the edge

full ball outside off stump, there is swing away from the right-hander but Dravid decides that this has to be hit, he moves forward with a long stride, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it powerfully through cover for four, he's off the mark in style
Sreesanth pitches outside off stump and seams the ball away from Dravid who once again lets the ball go, Sreesanth is bowling a testing line here and is getting the ball to move both ways
Dravid moves forward to defend a good length ball on off and middle stump, the ball hits the inside edge and goes towards square leg, that moved into the right-hander
Sreesanth pitches the ball full outside off stump and seams the ball sharply away from the right-hander, Dravid moves forward and lets it go again, that moved quite a lot off the pitch
Sreesanth pitches on a good length outside off stump, the ball holds its line and goes through to the wicketkeeper after Dravid shoulders arms
a good length delivery pitches outside off and bends back into Kohli who strides forward and defends towards the bowler
defended on the front foot towards the off side
flicked off the pads behind square to Sarwan at short fine leg

what an awful mix-up, Kallis is run out, Pathan pitched the ball outside off stump and swung it back into Kohli who moved forward and pushed the ball towards point, he set off for the single but changed his mind after a few paces, Kallis however had run a long way down and was stranded near the striker's end when the throw from Shaun Marsh came to the bowler
fuller length but the line is a lot straighter on off and middle stump, Kohli leans forward and defends
shot! Dangerous but well executed! Kohli walks across his stumps and flicks a full ball from middle and leg stump through square leg for Bangalore's second boundary

Kallis moves forward and outside the line of off stump, trying to get inside the line perhaps, Sreesanth pitches the ball outside off stump and seams it away from the right-hander, forcing Kallis to shoulder arms
good length delivery outside off stump, Kallis lets the ball go through to Uday Kaul
good length delivery pitches outside off stump and angles into the right-hander, Kohli moves forward and opens the face of the bat to steer the ball towards third man
a full ball but the line is down leg side, Kohli steps across his stumps and tries to flick but misses, umpire Davis calls it wide
a bit fuller and straighter on middle stump, Kohli walks across and flicks the ball to deep square leg, VRV fields and his throw is poor at the keepers end, the batsmen run overthrows
136 kmh on a tight line and length just outside off stump, Kohli lets it go again, excellent bowling
short of a length delivery pitches outside off stump and seams away from Kohli who waits in his crease and lets it go

he has to be careful here, he's getting a long way across to play Pathan on the leg side and if he misses he could be an lbw candidate, he doesn't miss though and clips the ball towards square leg for  a single
identical ball but Pathan gets away with it this time, Kohli moved his front foot across his stumps and tried to flick, his time he was too early and got hit on the pad
too straight from Pathan, on middle and leg stump, Kohli moves forward and across his stumps and plays a leg glance to the fine leg boundary
this time the line is closer to off stump and Kohli strides forward to defend, the ball leaves him and beats the outside edge
Pathan pitches outside off and slants it away from the right-hander, Kohli lets it go and umpire Doctrove calls it wide, that is pretty harsh
a fraction short on middle stump, Kohli moves across and flicks the ball elegantly off his pads, he's timed it well but doesn't find the gap at square leg
good length ball delivered across the right-hander from over the wicket, Kohli defends on the front foot back towards the bowler
good length ball and dead straight, Kallis gets behind the line and defends towards the leg side

bowled him! Awesome bowling, it isn't the outswinger this time, the ball pitches on a good length and nips back into the right-hander instead of seaming away, White pushes forward at it with a large gap between bat and pad, the ball finds it and crashes into middle stump

caught! Outstanding ball from Sreesanth, it pitched on a good length around off stump and seamed away from the right-hander, the line and length was accurate and Jaffer had to play at it, he was neither forward nor back and hung his bat out, the ball took the edge and Uday Kaul dived to his right to take a low catch
Sreesanth is getting the ball to swing, this one was full and Jaffer let it go as the ball bent away from him

excellent ball, the first two balls went away from Jaffer, this one pitched outside off stump and came back into the right-hander, Jaffer drove away from his body and the ball went through the gap between bat and pad
a full ball swings away from the right-hander after pitching outside off stump, Jaffer leans forward and drives firmly towards Chawla at cover
short and very wide outside off stump, there was a bit of seam movement away from the right-hander, Bangalore get on the scoreboard after the umpire signals wide
the winning run sums up Bangalore's match, Kumble bowls the ball way down leg side and concedes a wide, Punjab win by six wickets
Pathan levels scores in style, he steps out of his crease, gets to the pitch of the ball and smashes the googly far over the long-on boundary
short and wide outside off stump, it's so wide that Pathan hits it with the bottom of his bat as he tries to cut
short of a length outside off stump, Pathan cuts off the back foot in front of Kohli at point for  a single
good length delivery on middle stump, Pathan gets behind the line and defends on the back foot towards the bowler
guided down to third man off the back foot for a single
another slower ball on the pads, Pathan misses the flick and gets a leg bye behind square
Pathan tries to pull a sharp short ball but the ball hits the bottom of the bat and goes on the off side, he played the shot too early
good length delivery pitches on leg stump, Pathan fends it down on the leg side

good length delivery angling into the right-hander from round the wicket, defended on the front foot towards the leg side, Pathan wants the single and sets off from the non-striker's end but Jayawardene sends him back
banged in short by Zaheer, Pathan gets on top of the bounce and pulls towards deep backward square leg
Jayawardene pushes the ball gently past the bowler and calls Pathan through for the run
Pathan goes for another big drive and gets an inside edge towards the keeper who does well to dive to his right and get a hand on it

what an effort from Steyn but it's in vain, Pathan slashed at a short and wide ball and hit it towards third man, the ball was heading over the ropes to steyn ran to his right and dived full length, he stopped the ball but didn't know where it was as he got up and the ball touched the rope
good length delivery on off stump, defended towards point off the front foot
fuller length on off and middle stump, Jayawardene watchfully defends towards the leg side to see off Steyn's spell
quicker delivery angling into off stump, Jayawardene covers the line and defends towards point
good length delivery outside off stump, Jayawardene decides he doesn't need to play at it and lets it go
width offered outside off stump, Jayawardene moves back and punches the ball towards point
short of a length on off stump, Pathan pushes off the back foot towards Misbah at cover and runs the quick single
that is a quick short ball angled across Pathan, he tried to upper cut it but was late on the shot
full ball outside off  stump, Pathan moves forward and drives the ball behind point, Steyn fields the ball cleanly at third man

a fuller ball angles into middle stump, Pathan waits for it and plays the ball off his pads towards backward square leg, the throw from Misbah is rather weak and Pathan makes his ground while coming back for the second run  just before Patil breaks the stumps
tight line and length outside off stump, Pathan shoulders arms once again
pitches on a good length outside off stump and seams away from the left-hander, Pathan lets it go

bowled him! but it's probably too late for Bangalore, Zaheer angles a good length ball into the left-hander from over the wicket, Marsh tries to play across the line towards square leg when he should have been playing straight, he misses and the ball uproots middle stump, Zaheer is now the IPL's joint highest wicket-taker
played off the pads towards backward square leg, Steyn runs in to field but fails to pick up the ball, the batsmen take advantage of the fumble, the fielding has been below par today
Jayawardene pushes the ball with soft hands towards mid-on and calls for another quick single
Marsh chops a good length ball on the off side and sets off for the single, he hesitates as he sees the keeper running towards the ball but Jayawardene calls him through
short of a length outside off, Jayawardene cuts it down to third man for a single
good length once again but the line is wider outside off stump, Jayawardene calmly lets it go, he has the luxury of the low asking rate and can afford to do so
excellent ball, Steyn pitches on a tight length just outside off stump, the ball holds its line and goes past the outside edge of Jayawardene's forward defence
bowled fast at 140 kmh but the line is down leg side, the umpire calls it wide, Punjab bring up their 100, just 27 needed now
good length delivery outside off stump, Jayawardene tries to defend on the front foot but gets beaten
good length delivery on middle stump to finish the spell, Marsh defends towards point off the back foot
good length outside off stump, Jayawardene opens the face and plays the ball behind point
Jayawardene lets a good length ball go outside off stump

too short from Praveen, Jayawardene has ample time to get into a good position on the back foot and pull the ball in front of midwicket for four, he rolled his wrists and played the ball along the ground
fuller length on middle stump, Marsh moves forward and flicks towards midwicket
good length delivery pitches around off stump and angles across Marsh who waits on the back foot and drives towards extra cover
tossed up on leg stump, Marsh comfortably moves forward and flicks off his pads to deep midwicket, 12 off the Kumble over, he's conceded 29 off three overs
short of a length outside off, Jayawardene guides the ball towards third man off the back foot
defended on the front foot towards the off side
too short, too wide, Jayawardene waits for the ball outside off and cuts it hard into the gap at backward point, poor line from Kumble
Marsh plays the ball towards point for  a quick single
strays down leg side, wide called
dropped, Marsh came down the track and drove the ball in the air back at Kumble, Kumble moved to his right but couldn't hold on to the low catch, the ball runs to the straight boundary as well
tight line and length on off stump, Jayawardene defends on the off side and that is a wicket maiden from Praveen, fabulous over
this time Praveen nips the ball back into the right-hander, Jayawardene gets behind the line and defends on the leg side
Praveen pitches on a good length outside off and seams the ball away from Jayawardene who lets it go

caught! Praveen pitches the ball on a good length and gets it to bounce a bit more and seam across the left-hander, Yuvraj stays on the back foot and tries to drive on the up through cover, he gets a faint edge through to Patil and umpire Davis sends Yuvraj on his way
short of a length outside off stump, Yuvraj gets behidn the line and punches the ball powerfully to mid-off
short of a length ball pitches outside off and seams away from Yuvraj who fends at it off the back foot and gets beaten
defended on the front foot towards the leg side
Marsh gets his front foot across and sweeps Kumble firmly to the deep backward square leg boundary, the game's gone for Bangalore, well almost
defended on the front foot towards the off side
shocking fielding, Marsh moves forward and drives a full ball  towards backward point where Steyn lets it go through him for four
Marsh steps down the pitch and drives Kumble powerfully to the straight boundary, his batting is remarkably similar to Yuvraj
Kumble drifts down leg side and Marsh nudges the ball off his pads towards fine leg, Praveen gets a powerful throw in but Marsh is safely back for the second
Marsh leans forward and nudges a full length ball towards mid-on for a quick single
a full toss outside off stump, Yuvraj pushes it through cover point for a single

caught! Another short ball outside off stump, Sarwan tries to pull but is in no control whatsoever, he gets a top edge through to Patil, Sarwan has never been a confident hooker/puller an the falls to that shot once again
that is a sharp bouncer angled into Sarwan from over the wicket, Sarwan just about gets out of the way
too full angling into the left-hander from round the wicket, Marsh swings the ball through square leg for a single
good length delivery just outside off stump, pushed off the back foot towards point for one
bowled on a good length on middle stump, Marsh moves forward and defends towards the off side, he can afford to for the asking rate is a paltry 5.33
good length delivery pitches outside off stump and angles into Sarwan who moves right back and guides the ball towards third man, another single and Punjab are cruising
Marsh defends on the back foot towards the off side and Sarwan calls him through for the quick single
a good length ball angles into the right-hander, Sarwan moves back in his crease and whips the ball from middle stump towards deep square leg, these two have now added 50
good length and line on middle stump, defended on the leg side off the front foot
poor line from Kallis, down leg side, Marsh tries to play the leg glance but gets hit on the thigh, the ball beats the keeper and goes for four leg byes, erratic line
bowled fuller on off stump, Marsh strides forward and pushes the ball towards point for a single, only three runs off Kumble's first over
Sarwan moves back and pushes towards mid-on for a single, Steyn is rather deep
Sarwan leans forward and defends towards the leg side, tight line and length from Kumble
that is the googly bowled slower on off stump, Sarwan moves forward to drive but gets an inside edge on to the pad
bowled flat and fast on middle stump, Sarwan moves back and cuts towards point
bowled flat and straight on middle stumps, Marsh moves back and plays the ball off his pads towards square leg
fuller length on middle stump, Marsh flicks the ball into the gap at midwicket for one more
good length once again on middle and off stump, Marsh gets behind the line on the back foot and defends towards the bowler
good length delivery angling into the right-hander, Sarwan moves back and pushes the ball towards mid-on for  a single
played off the pads towards square leg for a quick single
too wide outside off stump once again, Sarwan cuts off the back foot and Kohli manages to get a hand on to it at point or else it would have been four more
that's another half-volley and Sarwan helps himself to four more by moving forward and playing an orthodox cover drive
that is too short and Marsh plants his front foot forward and pulls hard, he connects well and the ball just about clears the deep midwicket boundary, Marsh opens his six account
played off the pads towards square leg for  a single
that cut back into Sarwan quite a bit, the ball pitched on a good length outside off, Sarwan let it go and the ball seamed back into the right-hander and passed rather close to off stump
that is a gift,  a full and wide half volley, Sarwan climbs into it and dispatches the ball to the boundary with a powerful cover drive
Sarwan tries to cut a good length ball that cuts into him and cramps him for room, he gets an inside edge but it falls short of Patil behind the stumps
Marsh mis-times the front foot off drive and runs the single to mid-off
terrible line and length, Zaheer is giving it away here, that is short and wide and begging to be hit, Sarwan obliges and cuts the ball hard in front of point for four more
a bit too straight this time on middle and leg, Sarwan flicks and times it well but can't beat the fielder at square leg
too full outside the off stump, Sarwan uses the width and strides forward to play a powerful cover drive for four
bowled on a good length outside off stump, Sarwan thrusts his front foot forward and lets it go
too straight this time, slanting down leg side, Marsh tries to run it towards fine leg but gets hit on the thigh for leg byes
fullish length on middle stump, Sarwan moves forward and drives the ball towards mid-on

Marsh could have been out! He flicked a full ball crisply off his pads to square leg and set off, Sarwan sent him back and he had given up trying to regain his crease, the throw from square leg missed the stumps
fuller delivery outside off stump, Sarwan leans into the front foot cover drive and gets a single
Steyn bowls a full and fast yorker, Sarwan gets hit on the pad but it was missing leg
that is quick in the channel outside off stump, Sarwan moved back to defend but was beaten
bowled full down leg side, another wide, Bangalore are being generous with the extras

that's unorthodox! Steyn bowls the ball fractionally short, Sarwan isn't the best hooker or puller but he goes for it, he gets a top edge that sails over the fielder at fine leg, it was Steyn's pace that took it over the boundary
a fullish ball swings into the left-hander after angling across him, Marsh nudges towards mid-on for one
pitches on a good length around off stump and seams across the right-hander this time, Sarwan moves back and across and shoulders arms, end of a rather long over
a good length ball pitches on off stump and comes back into Sarwan who moves forward and manages to defend, excellent line this time
pitches on a good length outside off stump and seams away from Sarwan who lets it go
bizarre, that is so wide outside off stump that Patil had to dive across first slip to collect, another wide
too full and too straight, Sarwan moves forward and flicks firmly off his pads to square leg, Zaheer's lucky to get away with that
too full down leg side, poor line, this is a mixed over from Zaheer, umpire Doctrove signals wide again

caught! Zaheer bowls another full and wide ball outside off stump, Hopes moves forward and reaches out to drive the ball, the ball seams away from him and he hits it in the air towards cover where White dives to his left to take an excellent catch
that is full and very wide outside off stump, Hopes chases it with the expansive front foot drive but missed it by a few feet, wide called
too full on leg and middle stump, Hopes comes on to the front foot and flicks the ball crisply through midwicket for four, poor line and Hopes cashed in
slides on the pads and Marsh gets a delicate touch to it off his pads, it beats the diving Patil
lands it on a good length and gets Marsh forward to the pitch of the ball quickly as he taps it towards mid-off
bowls a much shorter one gets this one to to fizz past Marsh
gets bat on ball this time as he gets forward and taps a full delivery wide of mid-off
beware! Steyn pitches that on the corridor outside off and squares up Hopes with the late seam movement as he shuffles about at the crease
bangs it on a good length at a lively pace, he opens the face of the bat and steers it down to third man
